QUEZON CITY UNIVERSITY

CHED Accredited

Quezon City University is a full-fledged Higher Education Institution (HEI) formally recognized by the Commission on Higher Education (CHED), a milestone achieved in June 2021. This institutional recognition allows students to benefit from the Universal Access to Quality Tertiary Education Act, providing free tuition and access to various CHED-funded scholarships and financial assistance programs.

University Excellence

Established in 1994, Quezon City University (QCU) has evolved from a technical training center into a premier local institution recognized for its strong industry alliances and fiscal autonomy. Driven by the vision to be the top producer of employable graduates, the university offers diverse degree programs in engineering, IT, and business designed to meet both domestic and global market demands.

Computer Science

The Bachelor of Science in Computer Science at Quezon City University provides a rigorous academic foundation in algorithmic complexity, software engineering, and computational systems. This program is strategically designed to cultivate technical expertise and innovative problem-solving skills, ensuring that graduates meet the sophisticated demands of the global information technology sector.
